package settings

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestRenderContract(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("orders keys and omits trailing newline", func(t *testing.T) {
		got, err := Render(map[string]string{"z": "last", "a": "first", "middle": "value"})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Render() error = %v", err)
		}
		want := []byte(`{"a":"first","middle":"value","z":"last"}`)
		if !bytes.Equal(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("Render() = %q, want %q", got, want)
		}
		if bytes.HasSuffix(got, []byte("\n")) {
			t.Fatalf("Render() has a trailing newline: %q", got)
		}
	})

	t.Run("nil map is empty object", func(t *testing.T) {
		got, err := Render(nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Render(nil) error = %v", err)
		}
		if string(got) != "{}" {
			t.Fatalf("Render(nil) = %q, want %q", got, "{}")
		}
	})

	t.Run("escapes JSON and preserves decoded text", func(t *testing.T) {
		input := map[string]string{
			"quote\"key": "a \"quote\" and \\ slash",
			"controls":   "first\nsecond\tthird\r\b\f",
			"unicode":    "雪 ☃ café",
			"empty":      "",
		}
		got, err := Render(input)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Render() error = %v", err)
		}
		var decoded map[string]string
		if err := json.Unmarshal(got, &decoded); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("standard JSON decoder rejected Render output %q: %v", got, err)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(decoded, input) {
			t.Fatalf("decoded output = %#v, want %#v", decoded, input)
		}
	})

	t.Run("does not mutate input and is deterministic", func(t *testing.T) {
		input := map[string]string{"b": "two", "a": "one"}
		before := map[string]string{"b": "two", "a": "one"}
		first, err := Render(input)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("first Render() error = %v", err)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(input, before) {
			t.Fatalf("Render() mutated input to %#v, want %#v", input, before)
		}
		for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
			next, err := Render(input)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("Render() iteration %d error = %v", i, err)
			}
			if !bytes.Equal(next, first) {
				t.Fatalf("Render() iteration %d = %q, first result %q", i, next, first)
			}
		}
	})
}
